projects.title: The Receptionist
projects.summary: Routes developer prompts through local Ollama by default and lets users opt into cloud routing. Each reply shows the selected model, routing reason, latency, and estimated cloud cost. The benchmark compares three routing strategies across 100 synthetic prompts.

projects.title: Spark Insights
projects.summary: Profiles CSV and Excel data, runs regression or classification against a user-selected target, and compares model scores with a simple baseline. Training-only preprocessing and portable HTML and JSON reports make results inspectable.

projects.title: SparkDocs
projects.summary: Combines keyword and semantic retrieval with local reranking. Answers are grounded in selected evidence with citations that point to the original PDF page, Word paragraph, or PowerPoint slide.

projects.title: Sparkfolio
projects.summary: An open-source investing guide for readers in India. The browser readiness check and a local MCP server share one decision engine, so the same inputs produce the same results.

projects.title: RaTiO-CoRE
projects.summary: Explores collaborative reasoning with specialized language models. A Python orchestration layer assigns roles, manages shared context, and combines the models' responses.

projects.title: FlowScope
projects.summary: Compares ARIMA, SARIMA, ETS, and LSTM forecasts on uploaded time-series data and plots predictions against observed values and error metrics.
